acceptanceClaims: AE2 tests two conflicting independent sensor observations rather than claiming two conflicting world truths; both observations remain on the sensor plane
the exact accepted AE1 false receiver-visible claim is reused without resampling the Deceiver, preventing opponent-policy randomness from contaminating the treatment variable
sensor:ae2-a reports serviceCompromised=true and sensor:ae2-b reports serviceCompromised=false with distinct source identities, no declared source priority, and no prior source history
one shared DeepSeek/Harness Defender call receives the exact same conflict context in healthy and compromised hidden worlds and requests one adjudicating inspection without premature quarantine
the Agent-visible pre-truth context and objective do not prime Trust, Reputation, or confidence vocabulary
world truth is absent before the conflict decision and arrives only after separately admitted inspection execution
the world-truth result causally references both the Agent conflict-decision event and the physical adjudicating-inspection-executed event
after authoritative current world truth arrives, historical sensor disagreement remains evidence but no longer marks the current property as unresolved
healthy world truth produces zero further effects and preserves availability; compromised world truth produces quarantine and verified containment
this one-shot consumer does not require durable Trust, Reputation, confidence, source-history, freshness, or a new policy primitive
candidateLaws: conflicting independently sourced observations plus no source ranking or history do not justify arbitrary source selection
provenance plus UNKNOWN can be sufficient to trigger explicit authoritative adjudication for a one-shot evidence conflict
historical sensor disagreement does not imply current truth remains unresolved after authoritative current world truth is acquired
a concept appearing in Agent reasoning does not itself force a durable Security primitive
rejectedDesigns: describing AE2 as two conflicting world truths rather than two conflicting sensor observations
priming the Agent with trust/confidence/reputation fields before testing whether such abstractions are forced
keeping UNRESOLVED_CONFLICT in the post-truth context after authoritative current world truth exists
an acceptance runner that crashes when the Agent does not follow the expected post-truth trajectory
publishing adjudicating world truth causally from intent alone without binding the physical inspection-executed event
limitations: authoritative adjudication is available and costs only 2
the two sensor sources have no repeated historical record
source identity and provenance are assumed intact
the experiment does not test collusion, common-mode failures, stale observations, or adversarial source compromise
